title: Glowing trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE680'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bellGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF3A0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFC933'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo behind trumpet -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='44' ry='30' fill='#FF9900' opacity='0.18'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='32' ry='22' fill='#FFCC33' opacity='0.22'/>

  <!-- mouthpiece -->
  <rect x='14' y='46' width='7' height='9' rx='2' fill='#FFD24D'/>
  <rect x='14' y='46' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFF0A0'/>

  <!-- lead pipe / main tube -->
  <rect x='21' y='47' width='44' height='7' rx='2' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <rect x='21' y='47' width='44' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#FFF6C8'/>

  <!-- valves block -->
  <rect x='36' y='39' width='17' height='22' rx='3' fill='#FFC61A'/>
  <rect x='36' y='39' width='17' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFE580'/>

  <!-- valve caps -->
  <rect x='38' y='34' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <rect x='43' y='34' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <rect x='48' y='34' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='33' r='2.4' fill='#FFFAE0'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='33' r='2.4' fill='#FFFAE0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='2.4' fill='#FFFAE0'/>

  <!-- valve stem highlights -->
  <rect x='38.5' y='35' width='1.2' height='5' rx='0.6' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  <rect x='43.5' y='35' width='1.2' height='5' rx='0.6' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='35' width='1.2' height='5' rx='0.6' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- finger buttons -->
  <rect x='37' y='43' width='3.6' height='4' rx='1.4' fill='#FF9F1C'/>
  <rect x='42.2' y='43' width='3.6' height='4' rx='1.4' fill='#FF9F1C'/>
  <rect x='47.4' y='43' width='3.6' height='4' rx='1.4' fill='#FF9F1C'/>

  <!-- tuning slide loop below -->
  <path d='M40 61 L40 72 Q40 76 44 76 L56 76 Q60 76 60 72 L60 61'
        fill='none' stroke='#FFC61A' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 61 L40 72 Q40 76 44 76 L56 76 Q60 76 60 72 L60 61'
        fill='none' stroke='#FFF0A0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bell flare -->
  <path d='M64 42 Q78 38 88 26 Q92 22 93 30 Q94 50 86 66 Q80 76 68 66 Q64 58 64 50 Z'
        fill='url(#bellGlow)'/>
  <!-- bell rim -->
  <path d='M88 26 Q92 22 93 30 Q94 50 86 66'
        fill='none' stroke='#FFF6C8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bell inner shine -->
  <path d='M70 46 Q78 44 84 36' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2.4'
        stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M71 57 Q77 61 82 58' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2'
        stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- sparkles of glow -->
  <path d='M30 30 L31 34 L35 35 L31 36 L30 40 L29 36 L25 35 L29 34 Z' fill='#FFF6C8'/>
  <path d='M76 22 L77 25 L80 26 L77 27 L76 30 L75 27 L72 26 L75 25 Z' fill='#FFF6C8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='86' r='1.8' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#FFE066'/>

  <!-- sound wave arcs from bell -->
  <path d='M92 40 Q97 46 92 56' fill='none' stroke='#FFE680' stroke-width='2.4'
        stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M96 36 Q103 46 96 62' fill='none' stroke='#FFD24D' stroke-width='2'
        stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.65'/>
</svg>
